node.title: A=1 core-one active-trace core reduction
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, cancel all bad-domain factors with zero K trace from A,B,K and allocate any zero exceptional trace, obtaining the exact active-core system QV_a+P_XW_a=P_clZ_BE_a, QA_a+P_clZ_BB_a=P_XX_1, W_aB_a-X_1E_a=QK_a. Every factor of X_1 and, when present, E_a is active. Capacity proves that every bad-domain trace is active except in two b=0,D_*=1 boundary profiles: c=1 with exceptional-only activity, or c=2 with one active domain row of deficit one.
